name: get_national_holidays
description: Fetch national holidays for a specific country to see when they have public days off.

params.name: countryIsoCode
params.description: The 2-letter ISO country code (e.g., EE for Estonia, DE for Germany)

params.name: languageIsoCode
params.description: The 2-letter ISO language code for the response (e.g., ET, EN)

params.name: validFrom
params.description: Start date for the holiday search (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: validTo
params.description: End date for the holiday search (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: get_unemployment_rate
description: Fetch the official unemployment rate statistics for Estonia from the national statistics office.

params.name: Näitaja
params.description: The specific statistical indicator to query (e.g., unemployment rate)

params.name: Sugu
params.description: Gender filter (e.g., Male, Female, Total)

params.name: Vanuserühm
params.description: Age group category filter (e.g., 15-24, 25-49)

params.name: Vaatlusperiood
params.description: The observation period (e.g., year or quarter) to get data for

name: get_current_electricity_price
description: Fetch the current real-time electricity and energy market price for Estonia.

name: get_weather_forecast
description: Fetch hourly or daily weather forecast for any location including temperature, precipitation, and wind speed.

params.name: latitude
params.description: Geographic latitude of the location (e.g., 59.4370 for Tallinn)

params.name: longitude
params.description: Geographic longitude of the location (e.g., 24.7536 for Tallinn)

params.name: hourly
params.description: Hourly weather variables to include (e.g., temperature_2m, precipitation, windspeed_10m)

params.name: daily
params.description: Daily weather variables to include (e.g., temperature_2m_max, precipitation_sum)

params.name: forecast_days
params.description: Number of forecast days (1-16)

name: get_exchange_rates
description: Fetch the latest foreign currency exchange rates relative to a base currency.

params.name: base
params.description: Base currency code to convert from (e.g., EUR, USD). Defaults to EUR.

params.name: symbols
params.description: Comma-separated list of target currency codes to include (e.g., USD,GBP,SEK)

name: get_country_information
description: Fetch detailed country information including population, capital city, languages, currency, and geographic data.

params.name: country
params.description: Full or partial name of the country (e.g., Estonia, Germany, Finland)

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated fields to return (e.g., name,capital,population,currencies)

name: get_ip_geolocation
description: Fetch geographic location information for an IP address including country, city, region, and coordinates.

params.name: ip
params.description: The IP address to geolocate (e.g., 88.196.123.45)

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated fields to return (e.g., country,city,lat,lon,isp)

name: get_school_holidays
description: Fetch official school holidays and term breaks for a specific country and school year.

params.name: countryIsoCode
params.description: The 2-letter ISO country code (e.g., EE for Estonia)

params.name: languageIsoCode
params.description: The 2-letter ISO language code for the response (e.g., ET, EN)

params.name: validFrom
params.description: Start date for the school holiday search (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: validTo
params.description: End date for the school holiday search (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: get_current_time_by_timezone
description: Fetch the current time, date, UTC offset, and daylight saving time status for any timezone.

params.name: timezone
params.description: IANA timezone name (e.g., Europe/Tallinn, Europe/Helsinki, UTC)

name: get_air_quality
description: Fetch real-time air quality measurements including PM2.5, PM10, NO2, ozone, and AQI index for a location.

params.name: city
params.description: City name to filter air quality sensors (e.g., Tallinn, Tartu)

params.name: country
params.description: 2-letter ISO country code to filter sensors (e.g., EE)

params.name: parameter
params.description: Pollutant to filter by (e.g., pm25, pm10, no2, o3)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return

name: get_address_geocoding
description: Search for a geographic address and return its latitude, longitude, and structured address components.

params.name: q
params.description: Free-form address or place name to search for (e.g., Viru 4, Tallinn)

params.name: format
params.description: Response format: json, xml, geojson. Default: json

params.name: countrycodes
params.description: Comma-separated ISO country codes to restrict search (e.g., ee for Estonia)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)

name: get_word_definition
description: Fetch the definition, phonetics, synonyms, antonyms, and usage examples for an English word.

params.name: word
params.description: The English word to look up the definition for (e.g., ephemeral, resilient)

name: get_gdp_statistics
description: Fetch annual GDP and economic growth rate statistics for any country from the World Bank open data API.

params.name: country
params.description: ISO 2-letter country code (e.g., EE for Estonia, FI for Finland)

params.name: format
params.description: Response format: json or xml. Default: json

params.name: date
params.description: Year or year range to filter (e.g., 2020 or 2015:2023)

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of records per page (default: 50)

name: get_population_data
description: Fetch annual population count and growth statistics for any country from the World Bank.

params.name: country
params.description: ISO 2-letter country code (e.g., EE for Estonia)

params.name: format
params.description: Response format: json or xml. Default: json

params.name: date
params.description: Year or year range (e.g., 2020 or 2010:2023)

name: get_electricity_price_history
description: Fetch historical electricity market prices for Estonia over a specified date range.

params.name: start
params.description: Start datetime for the price history query (ISO 8601 format, e.g., 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z)

params.name: end
params.description: End datetime for the price history query (ISO 8601 format, e.g., 2024-01-31T23:59:59Z)

name: get_public_transport_stops
description: Fetch list of public transport stops in Estonia including buses, trams, and trains with their GPS coordinates.

name: get_average_salary_statistics
description: Fetch official average gross and net salary statistics for Estonia by sector, region, or time period from Statistics Estonia.

params.name: Aasta
params.description: Year of the salary data to retrieve (e.g., 2023, 2022)

params.name: Tegevusala
params.description: Industry or economic sector to filter by (e.g., total economy, manufacturing, IT)

params.name: Maakond
params.description: Estonian county or region to filter by (e.g., Harju, Tartu)

name: get_estonian_company_info
description: Fetch official company registration details from the Estonian Business Registry including name, registration number, address, legal status, and board members.

params.name: reg_code
params.description: Company registration number to look up (e.g., 10000000)

params.name: name
params.description: Company name or partial name to search for

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by company status: active, liquidated, bankrupt

name: get_reverse_geocoding
description: Convert GPS coordinates (latitude and longitude) into a human-readable street address or place name.

params.name: lat
params.description: Latitude of the location to reverse geocode (e.g., 59.4370 for Tallinn)

params.name: lon
params.description: Longitude of the location to reverse geocode (e.g., 24.7536 for Tallinn)

params.name: format
params.description: Response format: json or xml. Default: json

params.name: zoom
params.description: Level of detail for the address (3=country, 10=city, 18=building)
